atoms.b: The Mesoamerican Barrier Reef is one of the world’s largest reefs. It is in the Caribbean Sea and borders the ((++coasts centre)) of Mexico, Belize, Guatemala and Honduras.
The reef is home to lots of amazing ocean life. Here you can find over 65 types of hard ((++coral stone)) and over 500 different types of fish!
This reef is classified as critically endangered. Its health is threatened by human and environmental pressures, such as climate change and ((++pollution rainfall)).

trainers.instruction: Listen and select the correct statement.

b.sound: The Panama Canal connects the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans.
The Panama Canal connects the Arctic and Indian Oceans.
The canal saves ships from having to sail thousands of miles around South America.
The canal saves ships from having to sail thousands of miles around North America.
Each year, over 200 million tonnes of cargo pass through the Panama Canal.
Each year, over 200 million tonnes of cargo pass through the Grand Union Canal.

hint.label: Seven Wonders of the World
hint.text:
The Seven Wonders of the World are iconic global landmarks:

• Great Wall of China (China)
• Petra (Jordan)
• The Colosseum (Italy)
• Chichen Itza (Mexico)
• Machu Picchu (Peru)
• Taj Mahal (India)
• Christ the Redeemer (Brazil)
hint.sound: The Seven Wonders of the World are iconic global landmarks.

atoms.b: The ruins of Chichen Itza are located in ((++Mexico Alaska)) and are recognised as one of the Seven Wonders of the World.
atoms.sound: The ruins of Chitchen Itza are located in Mexico and are recognised as one of the Seven Wonders of the World.

atoms.b: Millions of tourists come every year to visit these ruins. One of the most famous buildings is the ((++Pyramid River)) of Kukulkan.
atoms.sound: Millions of tourists come every year to visit these ruins. One of the most famous buildings is the Pyramid of Kookle-kahn.

atoms.b: Chichen Itza was one of the largest cities of the Maya; an ((++ancient recent)) civilisation that lived in Mexico and Central America.
atoms.sound: Chitchen Itza was one of the largest cities of the Maya; an ancient civilisation that lived in Mexico and Central America.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Mexico’s climate differs significantly from north to south. While the northern half of Mexico is full of mountains and deserts, its south is dominated by dense tropical rainforests.
atoms.sound: Mexico’s climate differs significantly from north to south. While the northern half of Mexico is full of mountains and deserts, its south is dominated by dense tropical reinforests.

atoms.text: Mexico has two giant deserts in the north: the Chihuahuan Desert and the Sonoran Desert. Its northern landscape is also defined by two mountain ranges: the Sierra Madre Occidental in the west and the Sierra Madre Oriental in the east.
In the south of Mexico, you can find the Lacandón Jungle, the largest rainforest in North America. This jungle is home to a wide range of animals such as jaguars, tapirs and howler monkeys.
